plans.name: PowerFIX 24

terms.deposit_source: Security Deposit (see footnote 7): Security Deposit (“SD”) shall be collected and retained on behalf of Retailer by SP Services Limited (“SP”). Existing SP’s customers will not be required to provide additional SD. Non-existing SP’s customers will be required to provide a SD equivalent to 65% of the SD as determined and published by SP.
terms.deposit: None if you already have an SP Services account. Otherwise you pay a deposit of 65% of the amount SP Services sets, collected by SP Services.

plans.notes: EMA fact sheet (2026-10-08) and plans page (read in the built-in browser 2 Nov) agree; rate unchanged. Plans page card: 'Hot Pick! PowerFIX 24 24 Months Fixed Rate (with GST) $0.3090 /kWh Bill Rebate $120 Promo Code ONLINE'. Promo: rebate now S$120 with code ONLINE (T&Cs online_tnc_20261102.pdf: campaign 2 November 2026 to 6 December 2026, both dates inclusive). Fact sheet file renamed for the new rebate; the version date inside is 2026-10-08. Terms: the fact sheet says customers without an SP Services account pay a deposit of 65% of SP's deposit; our wording says only that there is no separate deposit (same finding as 26 Oct, not yet approved). ETF S$200 matches.
